# EZ Haulaway LLC

> Local, family-owned junk removal, hauling, and light demolition serving Parker, Castle Rock, and the greater Denver metro area in Colorado. We provide same-day and next-day pickup with upfront, honest pricing and full cleanup included.

- Business name: EZ Haulaway LLC
- Based in: Parker, Colorado (Douglas County)
- Phone: (720) 614-7223
- Website: https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com
- Owners: Ben and Zoe (owner-operated, family business)
- Equipment: red pickup truck with a 16 ft x 8 ft x 3 ft two-axle dump trailer (14 cubic yards, approximately 450 cubic feet)
- Price range: $150 minimum charge up to $850 for a full trailer load
- Service model: we do all the lifting, loading, sweeping, and disposal. Customers never lift anything.
- Disposal: metal is recycled, usable items are donated when possible, the rest goes to the proper facility.

## Services

- [Wood Pallet Removal](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/wood-pallet-removal): paid pickup of unwanted and broken wood pallets, scrap lumber and wood offcuts in Parker, Castle Rock and the Denver metro. Quotes depend on material, amount and access; no pallet purchasing or guaranteed recycling.
- [Dumpster Rental Alternative](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/dumpster-rental-alternative): dumpster rental vs junk removal comparison; full-service loading and hauling priced by trailer space.
- [Hoarder Cleanout](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/hoarder-cleanout): discreet clutter and hoarding cleanouts (hauling only, no biohazard cleaning).
- [Storage Unit Cleanout](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/storage-unit-cleanout): empty and haul away storage unit contents.

- [Furniture Removal](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/furniture-removal): couches, sectionals, recliners, dressers, tables, and bed frames. Couches priced at $60 per cushion.
- [Mattress & Bulky Item Removal](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/mattress-and-bulky-item-removal): mattress $100, box spring $75, treadmill $150, piano from $375.
- [Appliance Removal](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/appliance-removal): refrigerators $125-$150, washers, dryers, stoves, water heaters.
- [Hot Tub Removal](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/hot-tub-removal): full spa cut-down and haul away, starting around $500. Handles tight gates and narrow side yards.
- [Shed Removal](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/shed-removal): tear down and haul away wood, metal, vinyl, and plastic backyard sheds, contents included.
- [Deck & Fence Removal](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/deck-and-fence-removal): deck and fence tear-out with 300+ decks of hands-on experience.
- [Light Demolition](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/light-demolition): sheds, decks, fences, small slabs, and interior tear-out.
- [Garage Cleanouts](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/garage-cleanouts): full garage clear-out so you can park inside again.
- [House & Estate Cleanouts](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/house-and-estate-cleanouts): whole-home cleanouts for moves, rentals, and estates.
- [Construction Debris Removal](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/construction-debris-removal): drywall, lumber, roofing, and remodel debris.
- [Yard & Landscaping Debris](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/yard-and-landscaping-debris): brush, branches, sod, dirt, rock, and fencing.
- [Electronics & E-Waste Removal](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/electronics-and-e-waste-removal): TVs, monitors, computers, and office electronics.
- [Commercial Junk Removal](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/services/commercial-junk-removal): offices, retail, rentals, and property managers.

## Pricing

Pricing is based on how much space the junk takes up in the 14-cubic-yard dump trailer.

- Minimum load: $150
- 1/4 trailer: $250-$300
- 1/2 trailer: $400-$500
- 3/4 trailer: $550-$650
- Full trailer: $700-$850
- Extra labor, if needed: $50 per hour
- Specialty and oversized items (hot tubs, pianos, appliances) are priced individually.

Full pricing details: [Pricing](https://www.ezhaulawayllc.com/pricing)
